description:
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {5}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding six {C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

uses.name: Cryptic Trilobite
uses.cardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it
